name: XeedQ
description: XeedQ develops quantum processors based on spin qubits in diamond, producing compact, energy-efficient solid-state quantum computers. Awarded EUR 30 million by the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative, the company aims to deliver a 32-qubit fault-tolerant system by 2026. Its 2022 DLR award announcement targeted 256 qubits or more by 2026; the current roadmap commits only to "very-large qubit numbers … before the turn of the decade", without a year for the 256-qubit mobile processor.
